# Field blocks for Bulgaria

Bulgaria field boundaries (2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025) as fiboa GeoParquet + PMTiles, mirrored by Fields of the World from Ministry of Agriculture and Food. License: CC-BY-4.0.

- Latest: https://data.source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/bg/latest/bg.parquet
- All editions: s3://ftw/harmonized-field-data/bg/year=*/*.parquet (S3 via endpoint https://data.source.coop, path style, anonymous; hive_partitioning=true adds `year`)
- CRS EPSG:32635; `metrics:area` in m²; `year` = edition, `id` unique per edition only.
- Columns: crop:name, collection, metrics:area, id, crop:name_en, crop:code, geometry, block_id, bbox
- Docs: https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/bg/README.md, agent guide https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/bg/AGENTS.md, STAC https://data.source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/bg/collection.json
